title: Can Anthropic's IPO Revive the AI Trade as Yields Rise?
author: Kira1Cloud
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/yvk8zjfn332i1.png

Markets just wrapped up a solid week with S&P 500, Nasdaq 100 chalking up decent gains even as Treasury yields kept climbing. Bitcoin lost some steam along the way. Now all eyes are on Nvidia's first earnings post Jensen Huang's recent move and Anthropic's upcoming IPO—can these two finally shore up that shaky confidence behind the AI boom? Curious what everyone here is positioning for [this week?](https://www.moomoo.com/news/post/1004714239?global_content=%7B"promote_content":"11067213","promote_id":20795,"promote_type":43,"sub_promote_id":1%7D)
